author: jessica
_note: TYPE 3, THE TRAIL, the first Delve across THREE places: a note at one POI points to letters at another,
and both go to a third. Three links, then it ends (his: 'ok for the chain to end, otherwise its a
thradmill'). Built by Eliza 2026-10-08; every player-facing word is Jessica's, written 2026-10-08 on his
"yeah 2". The fiction: a soldier's unsent letters, taken home. The natural site is where he left a note,
the military one is where he served, the peopled end is where his sister lives. Nobody is placed at the
end (beats has no people block), so no box describes her as present.

place._theme: The END of the trail, peopled: somebody to hand the slates to.
place._themes: THREE DISJOINT POOLS, so no two links can be one site: the end is peopled (keeping the base's no-natural, no-cave exclusions); the first slate is at an unpeopled NATURAL site; the second at an unpeopled MILITARY one. Split on the two biggest themes in the pool (gen_delve keywords, 2026-10-08: Natural 121, Military 119); 'infrastructure and not peopled' was 16. Which fiction suits which site is Jessica's call.

prose.name: Errand: Soldier's Letters on <Planet>
prose.briefing: I came across a soldier's note pointing to a cache at the <SecondPlace>. Whatever he left there, he never came back for it.

beats.journal: The cache held a note from Private Teodor Brask. His letters are stashed at the <ThirdPlace>, and he asks whoever finds this to see they get home.

message.title: Field Note
message.text: The note is folded small and signed T. BRASK. His letters are stashed at the <ThirdPlace>. Whoever finds this, please get them home.

beats.journal: I've found Brask's letters at the <ThirdPlace>. They're all addressed to his sister at the <Place>, so that's where they're going.

message.title: Unsent Letters
message.text: A bundle of slates tied with wire. Every one is addressed to the same person, L. Brask, at the <Place>. None of them were ever sent.

beats.journal: I followed a soldier's note from the <SecondPlace> to his letters at the <ThirdPlace>, and left them in the post locker at the <Place> for his sister.
beats.name: Post Locker

message.title: Delivered
message.text: The letters go into the post locker with her name facing up, and the note on top.
